ruflo.release_body:
Security patch for `@claude-flow/cli`, `claude-flow` and `ruflo` (`latest`, `alpha`, `v3alpha` → 3.51.1). Upgrading is recommended.

**PreToolUse `pre-bash` denials now block (#3623).** When the hook handler recognised a denied command, it exited with status 1. Claude Code treats that as a non-blocking hook error, so the command could still run. Denials now exit 2, the status Claude Code's PreToolUse uses to block. The fix covers both shipped `hook-handler.cjs` copies and the handler `ruflo init` generates. Existing projects pick it up with `npx ruflo@latest init upgrade` (or a helper refresh).

**MCP tools send credentials only to configured services (#3624).** `x_federation_*` and `seraphina_guidance` read env-only credentials (`RUFLO_X_ADMIN_TOKEN`, `SERAPHINA_METALLM_KEY`). Their destinations are now pinned to the server-configured HTTPS base (`RUFLO_X_GATEWAY_URL`, `SERAPHINA_METALLM_URL`). A URL tool argument is only an assertion that must match that base; an absent, null or empty argument means no assertion. Every credential-bearing request rejects redirects. Operator configuration may name a loopback HTTP service for local or self-hosted gateways.

Verified: signed helper manifest at 3.51.1, witness manifests 117/117 on linux, macOS and Windows. A fresh `npx ruflo@3.51.1 init` writes the exit-2 handler.

orca.release_body:
Thank you so much for using Orca and for your continued support! ❤️

This patch is built from the September 30 daily build plus fixes picked from main. Pull requests that landed on main after that are not in this build.

## The short version

**Codex terminals:** When a Codex tab ends up sharing one background server with your other Codex tabs, a notice now appears at the top of that tab. On that server, closing one tab can end the others and agent status can be wrong. The notice offers a **Fix** that turns the sharing off and shows the exact command it runs. In a terminal that was opened before the update, it offers to open a new terminal instead. Typing `codex` in a plain fish tab now runs Codex on its own server, as it already did in zsh and bash. Opening a terminal no longer removes Orca's status hook from `~/.codex`. Orca no longer writes a second copy of a folder's trust entry into Codex's `config.toml`, which stopped every `codex` command from working, and it cleans up copies it already wrote. The background Codex usage check no longer clicks "Update now" in Codex's update prompt and leaves Codex broken. Codex also starts without a trust prompt in worktrees of a bare repository. A Codex pane no longer freezes for about a second while you type.

**Folder trust for agents:** When Orca starts Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot, Qoder, or Antigravity in a folder, it now answers the agent's "Do you trust this folder?" question ahead of time. Orchestration workers, automations, and agents started from your phone no longer get stuck waiting at that prompt. You can turn this off in Settings → Agents → "Trust the folder when Orca starts an agent".

**Agent status:** With several OpenCode 2 panes open, each pane now shows its own Working and Done, not another pane's. On Windows, Claude Code status works again when Claude runs its hooks in Windows PowerShell 5.1. A Codex row stays in the sidebar while Codex runs, even after Codex renames its tab. A freshly started Hermes is shown as ready, not busy.

**Native chat (experimental):** A message you send while the agent is working now waits as a card above the message box, on desktop and on the phone. You can **Steer** it into the running turn, edit it, or delete it. Otherwise it is sent when the turn ends. A subagent's work appears in its own section instead of being mixed into the conversation. `/compact` gets its own row, and an unfinished `/clear` no longer locks the chat. Stop responds faster and no longer shows a false "Cancellation was not confirmed". Pasting text works when you are connected to a remote Orca server.

**Orchestration:** A worker's "I'm done" report is no longer rejected after its conversation is compacted. If Orca is briefly unreachable, the report is retried for about two minutes instead of being lost. `worker-abandon` now settles a stuck worker every time.

**Files and editor:** If you saved a new untitled note and then closed its tab, Orca deleted it. Saved notes are now kept. Clicking in the rich Markdown editor no longer jumps to the top of the file. Open files switch with the system's light and dark mode. Sparse checkouts open the file explorer at the folder you work in.

**Terminal:** Images whose file names have brackets or spaces, like `download (1).png`, now attach to an agent when you drop them in. When dropped files are skipped, the notice tells you why. With many tabs open, the tab you're on stays visible at the edge of the tab bar. Programs like Codex and Claude Code now get the right colors when they start late or in the background.

**Linux and Windows:** On Hyprland, sway, river, and niri, Orca now encrypts saved API keys and tokens when your keyring is running and unlocked. If a credential is saved without encryption, Settings now shows a warning next to it. On Windows, the `orca` command is now a native program, because antivirus kept deleting the old one. It runs without the Visual C++ Redistributable. The installer no longer carries a duplicate copy of Orca's relay files inside the app archive.

**Terminals you already had open:** The new color answers and the `codex` setup in fish tabs take effect in terminals opened after the update. Terminals that were already open keep their old behavior until you open new ones.

## Known issues

**Windows on ARM:** The ARM64 package ships an x64 `orca.exe` command-line tool. Windows 11 on ARM runs it under emulation. Windows 10 on ARM can't run it, so the `orca` command does not work there (#24094).

**OpenCode 2:** OpenCode 2 panes that were already running before the update may show no status until you restart OpenCode in them. If you downgrade Orca after this update, duplicate OpenCode status plugins are left behind. After `opencode run` exits, its pane can keep showing "Done"; a fix is pending in #24472.

**Codex:** After you upgrade, Codex launches use Orca's managed Codex home until Codex approves Orca's new status hook. A resumed pane that uses `~/.codex` can pause for up to 30 seconds (#23552).

**Claude folder trust:** Folder pre-trust is on by default (Settings → Agents → "Trust the folder when Orca starts an agent"). On Alpine WSL, Orca can't copy the file permissions it needs, so Claude shows its own trust prompt instead (#23744).

---

## Product experience

### Codex & orchestration

*Codex tabs warn when they share a server, Codex settings and hooks are no longer damaged, and orchestration worker reports get through more reliably.*

* feat(terminal): warn when a typed Codex joins Codex's shared server (STA-9051) by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/24217
* feat(terminal): point an old terminal's Codex shared-server banner at a new terminal (STA-9051) by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/24501
* fix(terminal): give plain fish tabs Orca's codex function without changing fish's startup by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/24284
* fix(codex): opening a terminal no longer strips Codex hooks from the real ~/.codex by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23552
* fix(codex): recognise Codex's quoted spellings in config.toml, and repair Orca's duplicates (#22592) by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23958
* fix(codex): trust the worktree Codex starts in, not a guessed repo root by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23937
* fix(rate-limits): stop driving a hidden Codex TUI to read usage by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23806
* fix(codex): start short-lived Codex app-servers on Windows without cmd.exe by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23830
* fix(orchestration): accept worker reports without the dispatch capability by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23982
* fix(orchestration): stop minting and printing the dispatch capability by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23994
* fix(orchestration): worker-abandon settles a stuck worker and records who did it by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23983
* fix(orchestration): retry worker_done while the Orca runtime is briefly unreachable by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23984

### Agents & agent integrations

*Orca pre-trusts the folder when it starts an agent, OpenCode 2, Claude on Windows, and Hermes report status correctly, and onboarding focuses on installing skills.*

* feat(agents): pre-trust the folder wherever Orca starts an agent by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23744
* fix(claude): stop Orca making a WSL user's ~/.claude.json world-readable by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23973

### Native chat

*Experimental structured chats queue mid-turn messages as editable cards, give subagents their own sections, and handle Stop, `/compact`, `/clear`, and pasting more reliably.*

* feat(native-chat): hold mid-turn messages in a host-owned queue by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23726

* fix(claude): a restarted provider continues the subagent roster earlier runs journaled by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23758
* fix(native-chat): turn facts come from the turn record, and /compact is a message the chat sends by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23059
* fix(native-chat): an unfinished /clear or refused Codex rewind no longer locks the chat by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23524
* fix(native-chat): a failed turn ends on its error instead of folding it by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23679
* fix(codex): a Codex Stop is the interrupt alone, so it no longer says "Cancellation was not confirmed" by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23850
* fix(codex): say a full Stop wait can overrun quit's eviction budget, and unref its timer by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23859

* Fix Chat UI paste intake and pane routing by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23784
* fix(chat): decode Claude pastes and report terminal delivery uncertainty by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23788

### Terminal

*Codex panes no longer freeze while you type, programs get the right colors, and dropped files attach or explain why they were skipped.*

* fix(terminal): removing a workspace prunes that workspace's close records by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23683

### Mobile app & paired clients

*The phone gets the mid-turn message cards, phone swipes no longer type escape text, agents started from the phone follow your chat or terminal choice, and the notification service delivers more phone notifications instead of letting them expire.*

* feat(mobile): mid-turn messages wait as cards above the phone composer by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23736

### Browser

* fix(browser): a tab's phone identity follows the viewport actually applied by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23812

### Tabs & sidebar

*The current tab stays visible in a scrolling tab bar, and a running Codex keeps its sidebar row.*

* fix(sidebar): an agent's row stays while it runs, whatever its tab title by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23948

### Editor & files

*Saved untitled notes are kept, Markdown clicks no longer jump to the top, open files follow light and dark mode, and sparse checkouts open at a useful folder.*

* fix(editor): keep saved untitled notes when their tab closes by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23768

### Saved credentials

*On more Linux desktops, saved API keys and tokens are encrypted, and Settings warns when one is stored without encryption.*

* fix(secrets): seal credentials on Linux desktops Chromium cannot detect by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/24035

### Windows & packaging

*The Windows `orca` command is now a native program that no longer resembles the malware antivirus kept flagging and runs without extra Microsoft runtimes. The app also ships without a duplicate copy of its relay files.*

* fix(windows): replace the managed CLI launcher with a native one by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/24094

### Reliability & performance

*Adding or removing a worktree rescans only that project, and fewer git calls block the app.*

* perf(git): relist only the repo whose worktrees changed, and stop blocking main on sync git by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23998

### Tests, CI & maintenance

*Release builds pass their telemetry check again, the WeChat community link points to the current group, and many tests that could not fail were removed.*

orca.commit_message:
refactor(ai-vault): delete the unused session-scanner worker thread (#24607)

* refactor(ai-vault): delete the unused session-scanner worker thread

Production always scans through the forked session-scanner service process;
the worker thread was reachable only under NODE_ENV=test or the
undocumented ORCA_AI_VAULT_SERVICE_PROCESS=0 switch, and nothing fell back
to it on service failure. Remove the thread (spawn, client, protocol, entry,
tests), its build entry, knip and plain-node-guard listings, and the
backend switch, so session-scanner-background always routes to the service.

- Move the scan options type to the service protocol as
  AiVaultServiceScanOptions.
- Tests now mock session-scanner-service-spawn, the seam production calls.
- Repoint the hot-path listing reliability gate from the worker-client test
  to the service-client test, which covers the same bounded-queue,
  cancellation, and fault-restart properties for the real executor.

STA-9122

* test(ai-vault): cover the service's Claude-vs-OMP subagent lister choice

Runs the real service entry and subagent reader, replacing only the two
per-agent listers, so a swapped lister choice fails.

- Linux x86_64：下载并解压 `GenericAgent-Desktop-Linux-Portable.tar.gz`，执行 `chmod +x GenericAgent.AppImage` 后运行它。卸载时运行 `uninstall.sh`，再删除解压目录。

claude_codex_bridge.release_body:
# v8.7.5

Released: 2026-09-30

## English

### OMP/Pi control-input reliability

- Opening `/model` or another control-only native selector no longer terminates an active OMP or Pi ask as superseded. The shared extension still binds recognized CCB dispatches immediately, but unmatched input alone is no longer treated as a replacement provider turn.
- A genuinely different prompt supersedes the active request only when it reaches the provider's `before_agent_start` lifecycle boundary. Explicit native `session_switch` events and later recognized CCB dispatches retain their existing replacement behavior and diagnostics.
- The fix is lifecycle-based rather than a `/model` command whitelist, so future control-only selectors do not need command-name exceptions.

### Verification and upgrade

- 302 focused Pi/OMP, runtime-launch, FIFO, and dispatcher regressions passed; two existing opt-in smoke tests were skipped. The generated Pi extension was executed with Bun to verify control input, real replacement turns, and native session switches, and the generated OMP extension was checked against the same boundary.
- In a disposable v8.7.5 source project, real OMP 18.3.5 switched from `paratera2/grok-4.6` to `bingxing/AWS-GPT-5.6-Sol` while job `job_727bce7356c0` was running a tool. The same attempt remained running, then completed once with exact reply `CCB_RELEASE_875_MODEL_SWITCH_OK`; no `request_superseded` event was emitted.
- Update CCB, then restart affected OMP/Pi panes or reopen the project when current work can safely be interrupted. Existing panes keep their already-loaded extension until restart. No project, conversation, or configuration migration is required.
- Android metadata and release assets remain synchronized with the coordinated release pipeline. This release adds no mobile UI behavior.

### Known limitations

- Pi uses the same repaired generated extension and passed Bun lifecycle replay plus pane-adapter regressions, but an authenticated real Pi TUI `/model` switch was not run separately for this release.
- The fix prevents false supersession; it does not make the entire native model-picker interaction atomic or recover unsaved drafts and in-flight provider operations after a process crash.

## 中文

### OMP/Pi 控制输入稳定性

- 打开 `/model` 或其他仅用于原生界面控制的选择器时，不再把正在执行的 OMP/Pi ask 误判为已被替换。共享扩展仍会立即绑定合法的 CCB 投递，但不会仅凭一条未匹配的输入事件终止当前任务。
- 只有不同的新提示真正到达 provider 的 `before_agent_start` 生命周期边界时，才会 supersede 当前请求。明确的原生 `session_switch` 事件和后续合法 CCB 投递仍保留原有替换语义及诊断信息。
- 修复依据生命周期边界，而不是维护 `/model` 命令白名单，因此未来新增的纯控制选择器无需逐个添加命令名称例外。

### 验证与升级

- 302 项 Pi/OMP、运行时启动、FIFO 和 dispatcher 聚焦回归通过；2 项原有的显式启用 smoke 测试跳过。测试使用 Bun 执行生成的 Pi 扩展，覆盖控制输入、真实替换回合和原生会话切换，并确认生成的 OMP 扩展采用相同边界。
- 在一次性 v8.7.5 源码项目中，真实 OMP 18.3.5 在任务 `job_727bce7356c0` 执行工具期间，从 `paratera2/grok-4.6` 切换到 `bingxing/AWS-GPT-5.6-Sol`。同一 attempt 在切换后保持 running，随后仅完成一次并精确返回 `CCB_RELEASE_875_MODEL_SWITCH_OK`，没有产生 `request_superseded` 事件。
- 更新 CCB 后，请在当前工作可以安全中断时重启受影响的 OMP/Pi pane，或重新打开项目。已有 pane 会继续使用启动时加载的旧扩展，直至重启。无需迁移项目、对话或配置。
- Android 元数据及发布产物继续使用现有统一发布流程；本版本没有新增手机端界面功能。

### 已知限制

- Pi 使用同一份已修复的生成扩展，并通过 Bun 生命周期回放及 pane adapter 回归，但本版本没有单独执行真实、已登录的 Pi TUI `/model` 切换。
- 本修复解决错误 supersede，不保证整个原生模型选择过程具备事务原子性，也不恢复进程崩溃前未提交的草稿或正在执行的 provider 操作。

> ## Documentation Index

# v0.6.17

> 2026-09-12

Devin CLI 会话记忆、按需读取 SQLite 页，以及任务/会话绑定修复。

## 功能增强

### Devin CLI 会话适配器

`trellis mem` 通过现有的零依赖解析器读取 Cognition Devin CLI 会话，数据在 `~/.local/share/devin/cli/sessions.db`（WAL SQLite）。这不是 `trellis init --devin`（Desktop/Cascade），也不是 Factory Droid。（#614）

* `list` / `search` / `extract` / `context` / `projects` 支持 `--platform devin`
* OpenCode、ZCode 与 Devin 共用 `packages/core/src/mem/internal/sqlite-adapter.ts` 和 `packages/core/src/mem/platforms.ts`
* Devin 会话树要求 `main_chain_id`；缺少 tip 时返回 `devin-main-chain-missing`（不再回退到 `max(node_id)`）
* 解析前去掉 `CREATE TABLE` 的 `--` 行注释，这样 live `sessions.db` 里的 `parent_node_id` 和 `chat_message` 能被识别

## 问题修复

### SQLite 主文件页懒读

`packages/core/src/mem/internal/sqlite-readonly.ts` 里的零依赖 SQLite 读取器按需加载主文件页，不再把整个数据库读进内存。（#596）

### Pi 无头子代理提示

Pi `trellis_subagent` 把 ask-policy 提示转发到父会话。serving heartbeat 设置 `PI_SUBAGENT_PARENT_SESSION`（不用过期的 `PI_SESSION_ID`），设置 `PI_SUBAGENT_CHILD=1`，并丢掉继承来的 `PI_SESSION_ID`，让子进程自己签发会话 id。（#611）

### 活动任务会话回退

当前会话 id 缺失时，不再回退到项目里仅有的那条会话去解析活动任务。该回退改为显式 opt-in，避免一个会话绑到另一个会话的任务。（#608）

### archive 子任务 unlink 回滚

如果 `task.py archive` 在已经 unlink 部分子任务之后失败，会按清除前的快照把每个子任务的 `parent` 写回去。`children` 里的重复条目只快照一次，避免第二次访问把 `parent: null` 写回去。（#613）

## 升级

```bash theme={null}
npm install -g @mindfoldhq/trellis@latest
trellis update
```

无需 `--migrate`。
